title: Cancellation Reasons and the Missed Functional Capacity Evaluation Fee
content:
# Cancellation reasons and the missed-evaluation fee

On a Workers' Compensation Referral, the reason recorded on the latest cancellation of a Functional Capacity Evaluation appointment in the Appointment Series funded by the referral sets the cancellation-reason share of the missed-evaluation fee.

**Reason rule.** The cancellation-reason share is none of the fee where that cancellation's recorded reason is the patient's illness or a family emergency, eight tenths of the fee (0.8) where the recorded reason is transportation or weather, and the whole fee otherwise.

## Reason codes in the Appointment Series

| Recorded cancellation reason | Share of the fee |
|---|---|
| patient illness | none |
| family emergency | none |
| transportation | eight tenths |
| weather | eight tenths |
| work conflict | the whole fee |
| other personal | the whole fee |
| clinic cancelled | the whole fee |
| no cancellation recorded (a no-show) | the whole fee |

## Case (hypothetical)

The latest cancellation in the funded Appointment Series records weather as the reason. A fee of $150.00 at this stage becomes eight tenths of $150.00, that is $120.00.
